'''Wioletta Joanna Waleszczyk''' (28 March 1962 – 15 March 2020) was a biologist and researcher at the [[Nencki Institute of Experimental Biology of the Polish Academy of Sciences]].

== Biography ==
In 1988 she graduated in physics from the [[University of Warsaw]].<ref name="archiwumludzienauki">{{citeweb| url = https://archiwum.nauka-polska.pl/#/profile/scientist?id=24248&_k=llream| title = Prof. dr hab. Wioletta Joanna Waleszczyk| publisher = archiwum.nauka-polska.pl| accessdate = 2026-05-08}}</ref> In 1995 she obtained [[doctorate]] upon thesis ''Organizacja wzrokowych pól recepcyjnych neuronów jądra parabigeminalnego u czuwającego kota'' supervised by {{ill|Krystyna Dec|pl|Krystyna Dec}}. In 2006 she obtained [[habilitation]].<ref name="archiwumludzienauki" /> In 2017 she obtained title of professor.<ref name="archiwumludzienauki" /> She collaborated with [[Bogdan Dreher]].<ref name="dreher">{{citeweb| url = https://ane.pl/index.php/ane/article/download/2212/2206/2229| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20260508155102/https://ane.pl/index.php/ane/article/download/2212/2206/2229| archive-date = 2026-05-08| title = Bogdan Dreher (1941–2019)| accessdate = 2026-05-08| publisher = ane.pl}}</ref> She was awarded with Gold [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Cross of Merit]].<ref name="wspomnienie">{{citeweb| url = http://www.nencki.gov.pl/wspomnienie-o-prof-wioletcie-waleszczyk| last = Skup| first = Małgorzata | last2 = Czarkowska-Bauch| first2 = Julita | last3 = Wróbel| first3 = Andrzej | title = Wspomnienie o prof. Wioletcie Waleszczyk| publisher = nencki.gov.pl| accessdate = 2026-05-08| archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20200324081809/https://www.nencki.gov.pl/wspomnienie-o-prof-wioletcie-waleszczyk| date = 2020-03-16| archive-date = 2020-03-24}}</ref>
